_business_type_note: banks/NBFCs/insurers are out of scope; use --standalone when consolidation includes a captive lender

proven_fraud_or_fund_diversion.source: true/false; SEBI/ED/court orders, forensic audit, exchange filings

auditor_red_flag_3y.source: true/false; audit report qualification, CARO, auditor resignation letter

moat_evidence.source: list from: brand_leader_top3_share, lowest_cost_producer, technology_or_product_leadership, distribution_or_network_scale, pricing_power_passed_cost_inflation, regulatory_licence_or_scarce_asset

governance_pedigree.source: one of: tried_tested_group_or_mnc, clean_promoter_record_10y, professional_board_clean_record, limited_record

crisis_evidence.source: list from: operated_through_major_shock, market_share_held_or_gained_in_downturn, cost_reset_then_recovery, profit_regained_prior_peak_within_3y, no_distress_dilution_or_asset_sale

fall_cause.source: one of: market_wide_macro, input_cost_or_commodity, sector_temporary, company_specific_fixable, prolonged_neglect, no_fall, unknown, structural_disruption

temporariness_evidence.source: list from: revenue_or_volume_base_intact, management_corrective_actions_announced, precedent_of_recovery, trigger_reversing_or_time_bound, positive_catalyst_emerging

sentiment_evidence.source: list from: institutions_cut_ge_1pp_4q, broker_downgrades_or_target_cuts_6m, negative_media_or_sector_out_of_favour, earnings_estimates_cut_6m

disruption_risk.source: one of: low, moderate, high (technology making the product/service less relevant)

group_extension_listing.source: optional true/false: new listing of a proven group's business
